title: Replace math.hypot with squared-distance comparisons
details: math.hypot is called thousands of times per tick in all cell phases. Replace distance comparisons with squared-distance (dx*dx + dy*dy) to eliminate sqrt. Apply across all 14 phases in cell.step().
notes: Replaced 6 math.hypot distance comparisons in cell.py + 3 in main.py with squared-distance (dx*dx+dy*dy), avoiding sqrt in per-neighbor hot loops. Kept 10 normalization hypot calls (need actual sqrt). Removed dead 'import math' from main.py. Tested: syntax/import/50-tick sim/8s headless smoke test all passed.
